notes.title: Fishing Alone Demo is Now Available!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone, I'm TheSQUID, the developer of Fishing Alone and I’m excited to announce that the demo is now available and free to play![/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3789270/Fishing_Alone_Demo/?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]This demo showcases the core mechanics of the game and marks the very first public release.[/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback is incredibly valuable, feel free to share your thoughts, and suggestions, or report any issues you come across.[/p]
